idea-plugin.name: SSH File Explorer
idea-plugin.description:
Connect to a remote host over SSH and browse its filesystem from a tool window on the left side of the IDE.
  • SFTP based remote file tree with lazy loading
  • Double click a file to open it in the editor; saving uploads it back
  • Create / rename / delete / download / upload files and directories
  • Password or private key authentication, multiple saved connections
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.1
  • Added comfortable spacing around the SSH Explorer toolbar.

1.0.0
  • First release.
  • SFTP tool window with a lazy loading remote file tree.
  • Open a remote file in the editor; saving uploads it back to the host.
  • Create, rename, delete, download and upload files and directories.
  • Password or OpenSSH private key authentication with multiple saved connections.
  • Unknown host keys are shown with their fingerprint and require explicit confirmation.
